mappings.error: duplicate key value violates unique constraint "{psql_constraint}" - Detail: Key (uid)=({note_uid}) already exists
mappings.suggestion: Due to a known DHIS2 bug [DHIS2-12887], enrollments and events that include notes/comments (via the 'Comments about this enrollment' widget) fail to sync after they have been created on the server. To resolve this issue, run this command to remove the association (not the note itself): `docker exec -i {docker_container} psql -U dhis dhis --set=constraint_name='{psql_constraint}' --set=note_uid='{note_uid}' < {resources_folder}/delete-tracker-note.sql`

mappings.error: Category option combo not found or not accessible for writing data: `{category_option_combo_id}`
mappings.suggestion: Category option combo `{category_option_combo_name}` [{category_option_combo_id}] does not exist on the remote server or the sync user has no rights to write data to it. A category option combo has no sharings, it's inherited from its category options, so we need to update these sharings. Note that you will need also the clear the application cache for new sharing to apply. Steps: 1) Go to Maintenance App, click on section CATEGORY, then `Category option` in the left sidebar, and search for all the category options ('{category_option_combo_name}'), double-click, Sharing Settings, set Data -> Can Capture and view for the sync user: {base_url}/dhis-web-maintenance/index.html#/edit/categorySection/categoryOption. 2) Go to the Data Administration App, section Maintenance, check Clear application cache and click Perform maintenance.

mappings.error: not-null property references a null or transient value : org.hisp.dhis.security.apikey.ApiToken.key
mappings.suggestion: The metadata version includes an API token. DHIS2 never exports the key of an API token, so the version cannot be imported (ATOMIC or BEST_EFFORT). To fix it: 1) On the central server, remove the API tokens from the metadata version in DB and update the hash. Then clear the application cache. 2) In this instance, delete the metadata version from the datastore, then clear the application cache.

mappings.error: version="{version}" error_code="E4015" message="Property `url` refers to an object that does not exist, could not find
mappings.suggestion: Metadata version {version} includes documents uploaded as files on the central server. Files are not part of metadata versions, so these documents point to files that don't exist in this instance. In an ATOMIC version, the version is not imported, and the metadata sync stops at it until it is fixed. In a BEST_EFFORT version (reported as a warning), only these documents are skipped, and nothing needs to be done. To fix an ATOMIC version: 1) On the central server, remove the uploaded documents from the metadata version in DB and update the hash. Then clear the application cache. 2) In this instance, delete the metadata version from the datastore, then clear the application cache.

A user in this metadata version has an avatar (profile picture) on the central server. Files are not part of metadata versions, so the avatar points to a file that doesn't exist in this instance. In an ATOMIC version, the version is not imported, and the metadata sync stops at it until it is fixed. In a BEST_EFFORT version (reported as a warning), the user is imported without the avatar, and nothing needs to be done. Removing the avatar and creating a new version doesn't fix an ATOMIC version: instances still have to import the broken version first. To fix it: 1) On the central server, remove the avatars of users from the metadata version in DB and update the hash. Then clear the application cache. 2) In this instance, delete the metadata version from the datastore, then clear the application cache.

mappings.error: could not initialize proxy [org.hisp.dhis.category.CategoryCombo#{category_combo_db}] - no Session
mappings.suggestion: During a metadata sync, this error comes from an object updated by this version that uses data elements with Details disaggregation, usually a visualization. DHIS2 imported the metadata version, but failed right after the import, when it audited the object.The category combination of its details (internal id {category_combo_db}) was not loaded. The metadata itself is fine, but the version is not marked as imported, so the sync stops at it, and running the sync again fails the same way. To unblock this instance: 1) On the central server, fix the objects that use data elements with Details only disaggregation. 2) Update with the fixes the metadata version stored in DB and update the hash. Then clear the application cache. 2) In this instance, delete the metadata version from the datastore, then clear the application cache.
